title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
My first week of the MDS program filled with stress and anxiety as suffering from the study permit delay and not able to join in-person. I was originally super excited about going back to school to enjoy the vibe and energy. But unfortunately it ended with missing all the courses and deadlines, kept communicating with defferent departments trying hard on figuring out what could I do. But thanks for the understanding and help from all the instructors and course coordinators, I am still able to catch up with all the course materials and assignments. But indeed, I spent more time putting pieces together and digests on my own. It’s quite challenging though, gladly I successfully made it!
Anyway, really hope I could get back to school ASAP and meet all the fellows in person :)
(Sadly, I do not have a photo for the first week at school to post here…)

Why Data Science
Having been interested in math since a child, I enjoy dealing with numbers and have great passion in technology. With experiencing the technical fields from different industries, I decided to study further in data science and understand better about the AI techs.

Outside of Data Science
I would say travel is a part of my life. Having been to around 15 countries and had chance to work in tourism industry, made me a person who enjoys exploring, challenging and having fun. Curious about almost anything and 200% as a foodie.
